source_caption:
Locke takes place entirely inside a single moving car, following Ivan Locke as he drives through the night making a series of phone calls that gradually unravel his personal and professional life. The story unfolds in real time, with everything revealed only through these conversations, all set within the confined space of the car.

Tom Hardy is the only actor seen on screen, and he actually drove during filming across 8 nights while performing live. His performance is restrained yet deeply intense, carrying the entire film through voice, silence, and subtle emotion alone. The tension never breaks, held entirely by his presence and control.
-
📽️: Locke (2014)
Dir. Steven Knight
